roleContext.jobDescription: Tamsin Lending offers unsecured personal loans online and decides most applications automatically. The Data Scientist builds and recalibrates application scorecards, runs out-of-time validation for the model risk office, monitors population stability and arrears after release, and supports the production rollout of approved models through the decision engine's change process. Findings go to the credit committee. The modelling team has four data scientists and works with the credit policy team, which owns cut-offs and pricing. The model risk office signs off validation before any release.

requirements.text: Develops application scorecards using logistic regression or gradient boosting.
Runs out-of-time validation and documents the results.
Has supported the production rollout of an approved credit model through a change process.
Monitors population stability and arrears for models in use.
Presents model findings to a credit committee.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Data Scientist, Credit Risk Models

## Experience

- Credit Risk Analyst at Barnfield Finance, January 2021 to March 2024. Developed a 38-variable logistic regression application scorecard for personal loans from four years of booked-loan outcomes, binning each variable under monotonic weight-of-evidence constraints.
- Ran out-of-time validation on the latest twelve months of applications and wrote up the Gini, calibration and stability results for the validation file, including a comparison with the incumbent scorecard's Gini on the same sample.
- Prepared the scorecard's release package (coefficients, cut-off table, test cases) and checked the decision engine's test-environment outputs against the development code case by case before rollout, logging 400 test cases with matching outputs.
- Produced the monthly monitoring report after release, tracking population stability by score band and 90-day arrears by monthly cohort.
- Ran a champion-challenger simulation of the new scorecard against the incumbent on historic applications and presented the results to the pricing working group, which used it when choosing the cut-off for the new scorecard.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised extract of the May 2023 monitoring report, showing population stability by score band, arrears curves for three cohorts and a drift alert that was investigated and closed, with the closing note signed by the candidate.
